indexes: CREATE INDEX listing_inquiries_listing_created_idx ON public.listing_inquiries USING btree (listing_id, created_at DESC)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_inquiries_pkey ON public.listing_inquiries USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX listing_inquiries_seller_created_idx ON public.listing_inquiries USING btree (seller_id, created_at DESC)

triggers.name: shopping_accepted_inquiry
triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER shopping_accepted_inquiry AFTER INSERT ON listing_inquiries FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION record_shopping_outcome()

constraints.name: listing_inquiries_buyer_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (buyer_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: listing_inquiries_listing_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES asks(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: listing_inquiries_seller_id_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (seller_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
